name: Yaowang Bifang
source:
The light of the sunset’s afterglow in summer presents its enchanting glory as if singing to welcome the coming autumn breeze.
The gorgeous manjusaka blooms without exception.
Among the manjusaka in clusters, Eureka, my dear sister, is making her choice.
“Would you like to be my opposite bank?”
Since then, the hero—Muse, has been meditating on that question with confusion for one week.
But it doesn’t go smoothly and troubles follow one after another.
A girl who is always so sunny and optimistic, why is her perseverance beyond reach?-- Hope
A girl who has no sense of existence, why are all of her efforts useless?—Jade
Their debut makes my way ahead more complicated and confusing.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/782690/Gazing_from_beyond/]Steam[/url] page]
translation:
夏日的夕阳余晖，呈现出迷人的光彩，仿佛在歌唱，迎接即将到来的秋风。
华丽的曼珠沙华无一例外地绽放。
在簇拥的曼珠沙卡中，我亲爱的妹妹尤里卡正在做出她的选择。
“你愿意做我的对岸吗？”
此后，主人公缪斯整整一个星期都在困惑地思考着这个问题。
但事情并不顺利，麻烦接踵而至。
一个总是那么阳光乐观的女孩，为何她的毅力却遥不可及？——希望
一个没有存在感的女孩，为什么她的努力都是徒劳？——Jade他们的首次亮相让我的前进之路变得更加复杂和混乱。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/782690/Gazing_from_beyond/]Steam[/url] 页面]
